Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:
Cover Letter Dated 15 June 2021; Unnumbered Planning Statement; Unnumbered Design and Access Statement dated 11 June 2021; Unnumbered Landscape Strategy dated 11 June 2021; Unnumbered Transport Statement dated 11 June 2021; Unnumbered Car Park Management Plan dated 11 June 2021; Unnumbered Energy Statement dated 11 June 2021; Unnumbered Travel Plan dated 11 June 2021; Unnumbered Delivery and Servicing Plan dated 11 June 2021; Unnumbered Ground Investigation Report dated 11 June 2021; LBH Drainage Assessment Form dated 12th March 2021; 7747.00 Location plan; 7747.01 Existing ground floor; 7747.02 Existing first floor; 7747.03 Existing roof plan; 7747.04 Existing elevations; 7747.05 Existing Sections; 7747.13 Waste Management Plan. Received: 16/06/2021. Unnumbered Response to consultation comments (dated 27th September 2021). Received: 13/09/2021.; Drainage/SUDS Maintenance Strategy ref: 221097 dated September 2021; Transport Technical Note ref: TN01 Rev: C Dated 27 September 2021; 7747.15 Proposed staff cycle parking; 7747.16 Rev: A Proposed visitor cycle parking; 7747.17 Rev: A Proposed staff cycle parking. Received: 27/09/2021.
Construction Logistics Plan [dated 30 June 2022], prepared by Markides Associates. Received: 19/07/2022. Air Park Way, Feltham, TW13 7EQ. IDL Discharge of conditions [dated 10 January 2022], prepared by JaK Studio LLP and Proposed GA Elevations. Received: 20/06/2022. Planning Statement. Received: 08/08/2022. Drawing 22026-MA-XX-XX-DR-C-0130 P03. Received: 30/09/2022.
Drawings 7747.006C, 7747.007C, 7747.008C, 7747.009C, 7747.010C, 7747.011C and 7747.012C Cover Letter (dated 28 January 2025) and Design Document (Rev.C, dated 25 January 2025), received 30/01/2025.
Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 2 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties and to ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of the locality.
Condition : 3 - All Non-road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) used during the course of the development that is within the scope of the GLA 'Control of Dust and Emissions during Construction and Demolition' Supplementary Planning Guidance (SPG) dated July 2014, or any successor document, shall comply with the emissions requirements therein 
Reason: In the interests of mitigating against negative air quality impacts.
Condition : 4 - All work on-site shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved details: Construction Logistics Plan [dated 30 June 2022], prepared by Markides Associates. Received on 19/07/2022.
Reason: To ensure highway safety is maintained and preserved.
Condition : 5 - Within six months of the date of this decision, full details and samples of all materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Details must include a detailed schedule of materials, a photographic sample board and rendered drawings, elevations and sections at a sufficient scale (1:20 or 1:50) to illustrate how all external materials will appear together.
The samples/details shall include:
(a) Brick/stonework (including brick, stone, masonry, brick panels, feature brick panel, brick framing feature and mortar on-site sample panel, minimum one metre by one metre) including all mortar colours, joint type, brick bond to show close match with existing building;
(b) Cladding materials / render (including specifications where relevant);
(c) Tiles / roof covering; including parapet coping / capping materials, dormers and canopies;
(d) Window types; and sectional drawings of reveals / sills / head details
(e) Balcony details (including soffits, panels and frame);
(f) All privacy measures (including obscure glazing details, privacy screens etc.);
(g) Balustrading treatment to balconies and roof areas (including details / sections / materials); and handrails
(h) Any other materials/details / fittings to be used (including solar panels, extract vents, rainwater goods, boiler flues etc.), with sections and on-site samples where appropriate
(i) Balustrading treatment (including details / sections / materials); and
(j) Any other materials / details / fittings to be used (including solar panels, extract vents, boiler flues etc.), with sections and on-site samples where appropriate
The development shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter.
Reason: In order to protect the appearance of the area.
Condition : 6 - No development above ground level, excluding demolition or site investigations, shall take place until a Stage 1 and Stage 2 Road Safety Audit for the site access has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
The development shall thereafter be implemented and maintained in accordance with the approved details.
Reason: In the interests of the safety of pedestrians and vehicles, to protect neighbours' living conditions and to support sustainable transport objectives and road safety.
Condition : 7 - During the course of the development:
a) The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess any such additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.
b) Soils or other landscaping materials imported to the site should be demonstrated to be safe for use in accordance with a scheme of verification and testing to be agreed with the local authority.
Before the development is first brought into use:
c) The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clause a) and b) above, including any amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
Reason: To demonstrate that the site does not pose a risk from contamination of land.
Supporting notes:
a. An initial phase 1 desk study and phase 2 site investigation have been submitted with the original application and are considered satisfactory. However, a watching brief for contamination is required.
b. The validation report shall revisit the site conceptual model/additional works identified, and provide evidence that each aspect of the decontamination scheme was carried out completely and successfully. This report shall prove that the development is suitable for its new use.
Condition : 8 - The soft landscaping as detailed within the Unnumbered Landscape Design Strategy Submission dated 11th June 2021 � save for where it is varied under this permission, shall be carried out during the first planting and seeding seasons following completion of construction works or first occupation.
Any trees or shrubs planted (including any such replacements) which die within five years from the date of planting shall be replaced in the next planting season with the same species, and of comparable maturity. The development shall be maintained in accordance with the approval.
Reason. In the interest of biodiversity, sustainability, and to ensure that a satisfactory standard of visual amenity is provided and maintained.
Condition : 9 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawings hereby approved shall be constructed and be made available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall be permanently retained and not be used for any other purposes.
Reason: In order to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the adjacent highway and the premises, and in the interests of road safety.
Condition : 10 - Notwithstanding the submitted details, Prior to the first use or occupation of the development full details (including manufacturers' specifications) of secure covered cycle parking facilities that accord with the West London Cycle Parking Guidance for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before the development is first occupied or brought into use, The approved facilities shall be thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 11 - Either side of the vehicle access hereby approved, visibility splay areas (the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, with a splay of at least 2.4 metres x 2.4 metres) shall be provided before the access and parking area is brought into use. These areas shall be kept clear of any obstructions to visibility greater than 600 mm in height, including shrubs, planting, boundary walls, fences, gates, other means of enclosure or other structures or objects at all times.
Reason: To ensure adequate visibility for drivers entering and leaving the site in the interests of pedestrian and vehicle safety.
Condition : 12 - No part of the development hereby approved shall be occupied until full details of the Electric Vehicle Charging Points, each capable of a minimum output of 7.2kW, are submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include manufacturer's specifications and the number of spaces provided with active and passive capabilities shall comply with the London Plan standards.
The charging points shall be installed in accordance with the approved details, with photographic evidence submitted to the Local Planning Authority upon completion, and so maintained at all times thereafter.
Reason: In order to promote sustainable modes of transport.
Condition : 13 - No part of the development hereby approved shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and copies of installation contracts, along with a written confirmation) has been submitted to the local planning authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme hereby approved has been completed in accordance with the submitted final detailed drainage designs. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.
Reason: In order to ensure that the methods to mitigate the risk of surface water flooding have been implemented as agreed and that the drainage system is suitably managed.
Condition : 14 - The development shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved details: Air Park Way, Feltham, TW13 7EQ. IDL Discharge of conditions [dated 10 January 2022], prepared by JaK Studio LLP. Received on 20/06/2022, Proposed GA Elevations. Received on 20/06/2022.
Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and area.
Condition : 15 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the existing vehicular access to Air Park Way shall be permanently closed and kerbs and footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.
Reason: To enhance the pedestrian environment and to confine vehicular access to the permitted points in order to ensure that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or highway safety along the adjacent highway.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow the change drawings listed in the condition of planning permission 00167/Q1/P2 approved 03/10/2022 for the variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to revise the access point to the site from Air Park Way of planning permission 00167/Q1/P1 dated 16/12/2021 for the erection of a two-storey side extension to existing building. Replacement of existing boundary fence with metal fence incorporating a new pedestrian access at the rear and installation of rising bollards at the front vehicle entrance. Alterations to car parking layout and provision of bin storage, cycle parking and associated landscaping
